title: Political Economics of Marxism and Leninism

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the core theories of Marxist and Leninist political economics, including labor value theory, surplus value, and market dynamics.
Develop the ability to analyze and evaluate economic relationships and interests in the context of modern economic development.
Demonstrate the capability to independently study and accumulate knowledge to enhance professional competence.
Become a global citizen, ready to actively demonstrate social responsibility.
Analyze market structures, competition, and monopolies in capitalist and socialist market economies.
Understand and evaluate economic policies in the context of socialist-oriented market economies.
Apply research methods to study economic phenomena and relationships.
Formulate a sense of social responsibility and ethical awareness in economic activities.
